patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ecwid and OpenCart share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Ecwid only if your buying job matches “Embeddable storefront you add to an existing site — Starter $5/mo, Venture $29 annual, Bus” rather than OpenCart's shape. Choose OpenCart only if your buying job matches “GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud cited ~$59–$99/mo by” rather than Ecwid's shape. Workflow advantage: Ecwid leans checkout-conversion; OpenCart leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ecwid and OpenCart share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Ecwid is Embeddable storefront you add to an existing site — Starter $5/mo, Venture $29 annual, Business $49, Unlimited $119 (post 2 Mar 2026 tiles);; OpenCart is GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud cited ~$59–$99/mo by secondary sources (confirm live). WooCommerce kee.
- Company-size focus: Ecwid (solo, micro, small-business) vs OpenCart (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Ecwid-leaning checkout-conversion vs OpenCart-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Ecwid — Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products; OpenCart — Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0.

Limitations — Ecwid: Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products; POS / omnichannel is limited versus Lightspeed Retail or Square; OpenCart: Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0; Managed cloud floors are not first-party confirmed here — confirm live before budgeting.

Poor-fit cases: Ecwid is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products · OpenCart is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0 · Avoid Ecwid if you actually need OpenCart's motion (GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud cited ~$59)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
